prompt:
groupby month,msg type
get avg number of them
query:
SELECT msg_name, AVG(cnt) AS avg_count_per_month
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', timestamp) AS month, msg_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM message
    GROUP BY month, msg_name
) 
GROUP BY msg_name
